Calculation Details

MetricValueNote

How to convert feet to meters

Multiply feet by the exact conversion factor 0.3048. When a measurement includes inches, divide the inches by 12, add that value to the feet, and then multiply the total feet by 0.3048.

meters = (feet + inches / 12) x 0.3048

Feet and inches example

For 5 feet 10 inches, the calculation is (5 + 10 / 12) x 0.3048 = 1.778 meters. The calculator also reverses meters into feet and remaining inches.

Measurement reference

The international foot is exactly 0.3048 meter. The meter is the SI base unit for length; see the NIST guide to SI length for the official US measurement reference.

Frequently asked questions

How many meters are in one foot?

One foot equals exactly 0.3048 meter.

How do I convert meters back to feet?

Divide meters by 0.3048. This calculator also separates the decimal result into whole feet and remaining inches.
